polityNote: French Republic (French State 1940–1944, Provisional Government, Fourth and Fifth Republics), metropolitan France. First level = the départements: 90 from 1922 to 1967, 95 from 1968-01-01, 96 from 1976-01-01 (Corsica split; drawn from then by data/hist-admin-fill.js). 1870–1940 is left to the TRF-GIS import (docs/HIST-RECONSTRUCTION.md §4); the scope starts in 1943 because the INSEE event list (the completeness proof for commune transfers between departments) starts then. Alsace-Moselle was annexed de facto by Germany 1940–1944 (statoids); the departments persisted de jure and the build's test 3 withholds ground the era map places in another polity. Boundary rectifications between communes of two departments that move only parcels are not commune events in the COG; none is known to us but the COG cannot prove their absence. Atoms: geoBoundaries FRA ADM2 (IGN, 2022).
